subject: CODE consuming stable team geometry with uniform transparent margin crop
body: PartyTray now consumes ORCHARD_UI_KIT.team and ORCHARD_UI_GEOMETRY.team, original App portrait callback. For readable long-name+AP stats at350phone, viewport uniformly crops only known transparent outer margin visibleBounds41..470, maintaining underlying sprite aspect and geometry transforms; display390desktop/350phone. Text14desktop/13phone, separate name+compact health/AP, full role/discipline in Party drawer and title. No bitmap changes.
